example_en: Schools should crack down on online bullying.

example_en: Several clients vouched for the quality of the service.
example_uz: Bir nechta mijoz xizmat sifatini tasdiqladi.

example_en: Who can vouch for the accuracy of these figures?

example_en: Extra examples will shore up your argument.

example_en: She took a short walk to shake off her tiredness.
